verdict.rationale: Zamzar's developer docs include example requests aimed at a dedicated sandbox endpoint and 'fully tested code samples', so the examples can be run against a test environment. Nothing shows an interactive, in-browser API explorer, and probes found no OpenAPI or Swagger spec at the candidate paths that such tooling would typically use. missing for 10: an interactive try-it console or explorer in the reference, a machine-readable OpenAPI spec, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the runnable examples.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
